decision: Retain Stop 3C as a useful isolated baseline, but do not proceed to CPU admission. Further retiming is required: live resident admission through the existing SWP/CPU exclusion boundary (-3.758 ns hot104), SWP-to-board fanout (-3.535 ns), and certificate/way/read arbitration into physical RAM-B (-2.705 ns). The probe cut improves hot/cold global setup by 0.773/1.214 ns; it does not establish closure or justify widening admission.
